description: Searches active NYC rental listings from StreetEasy, LeaseBreak, NYBits, Reddit, and building websites, plus lease takeovers posted on Buzzedin. Supports price, bedrooms, neighborhoods, boroughs, move-in dates, commute time to an address, distance to places (subway, grocery, a named store), amenities, rent-stabilized buildings, lease takeovers, and apartment qualities like natural light or quiet. Returns up to 8 listings with a deal-score estimate, how each rent compares to its neighborhood median, selected structured features such as laundry, outdoor space, pets and light, plus a public detail link for each apartment. Enrichment and deal scores are estimates; confirm details on the listing. Fetch the next page to see more results.

borough.description: Borough name if mentioned: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island

commuteFilter.description: Filter by commute time to a SPECIFIC location

destination.description: Specific address, place name, or landmark (e.g., "Grand Central", "350 5th Ave", "my office at 123 Main St")

maxMinutes.description: Maximum commute time in minutes. Use 30 when the query does not specify.

mode.description: Transportation mode (walking, transit, cycling, driving). Use "transit" when the query does not specify.

hasOutdoorSpace.description: Private outdoor space required (balcony, patio, backyard, terrace, roof)

maxPrice.description: Maximum monthly rent in dollars. Extract from phrases like "under $X", "under X", "less than $X", "max $X", "$Xk", "Xk" where k=1000. Examples: "5k"=5000, "$4k"=4000, "under 3500"=3500

maxSqft.description: Maximum square footage. Extract from phrases like "under X sqft", "less than X sq ft", "max X square feet"

minSqft.description: Minimum square footage. Extract from phrases like "at least X sqft", "X+ sqft", "over X sq ft", "minimum X square feet"

moveInAfter.description: Earliest acceptable move-in date as YYYYMMDD (for example, 20260801 for August 1, 2026). Only set this when the user wants listings available on or after a specific date — for example "not until August" or "earliest move-in August 1".

moveInBy.description: Latest acceptable move-in date as YYYYMMDD (for example, 20260701 for July 1, 2026). Only set this when the user gives a move-in deadline.

neighborhoods.description: Extract specific NYC neighborhood names. Map abbreviations to full names: "LES"="Lower East Side", "UES"="Upper East Side", "UWS"="Upper West Side", "FiDi"="Financial District", "BedStuy"="Bedford-Stuyvesant", "LIC"="Long Island City", "DUMBO"="DUMBO". Map general areas to specific neighborhoods: "Lower Manhattan" -> ["Financial District", "Tribeca", "Battery Park City", "Chinatown", "Civic Center"]. Use exact neighborhood names.

page.description: Results page, starting at 1. Use only when the user asks for more results.

poiCommuteFilters.description: ONLY for generic POI types like "a grocery store". For specific brands (Whole Foods, Equinox), use commuteFilter instead

maxMinutes.description: Maximum time in minutes. EXTRACT exact time from query (e.g., "5 min" = 5, "10 min" = 10). If not specified, default to 10.

mode.description: Mode - walking or cycling. Use "walking" when the query does not specify.

poiType.description: Generic POI category. ONLY for generic requests like "a grocery store", "a gym", "a subway". NEVER use this field when the user names a specific brand (Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, Equinox, Starbucks, CVS, etc.) — brands must go in commuteFilter instead.

rentControlledClaimed.description: The listing itself says the unit is rent-stabilized. Much rarer; use only when the user wants the listing to state it.

rentControlledVerified.description: Building is on the NYC (DHCR) list of buildings with rent-stabilized units. Use this when the user asks for rent-stabilized apartments.

spacious.description: Apartment feels above-average in size for its bedroom count. Match spacious or very spacious listings.

name: search_listings
title: Search NYC apartments
